text: Ferry Shipping News calls Marios Iliopoulos the owner of Seajets; Neos Kosmos describes him as co-founder and CEO of SeaJets, one of Greece's leading high-speed ferry companies.
short: Seajets is owned by its co-founder and CEO, Marios Iliopoulos.

source.name: Ferry Shipping News: Seajets Owner Marios Iliopoulos Invests in Cruise Ships
source.quote: Seajets Owner Marios Iliopoulos Invests in Cruise Ships
